newsitem.title: USA: Piazztec acquires stone wares maker.
newsitem.headline: Piazztec acquires stone wares maker.

text.p: Piazztec International Inc, formerly American Network Technologies Inc, said Monday it has acquired Piazztec International LLC for 4.5 million common shares.
The acquiring company said it also issued an additional 4.5 million common shares to various individuals for their services and for future financing.
Following the acquisition, which closed on June 10, Piazztec said it has 10,019,720 common shares issued and outstanding.

According to Piazztec's news release, the acquired company has contractual right to a proprietary method of manufacturing stone products. The process allows the manufacture of "bent stone" furniture and decorative products such as tables, desks, wall sconces and room dividers, it said.
A company spokesman said American Network Technologies was a shell company that originally intended to be in telecommunications, but had been dormant for a number of years.
